_comment: THE source of truth for phrase wording, in both languages. Python reads this
file via nslr/config.py; Dart loads it as a bundled asset in LocalRecognizer.
Neither language declares the strings itself, so they cannot drift apart.
It lives under app/assets/ for one reason only: Flutter cannot bundle an asset
from above its package root, so a copy at the repo root would have to be kept
in sync with this one -- which is the exact failure this file exists to remove.
KEY ORDER IS SIGNIFICANT. record.py builds its class folders and its radio
buttons from it, and parity_spike.py indexes into it. Keep it as-is.
`ne` is null for `none` on purpose: a rejected sign must have no Nepali text
to show and no audio to play. Same reason there is no ne/none.wav.
Changing wording here changes labels only -- class keys are what the model
was trained on, so no retraining, re-export or OOD refit is involved.
